answer: Require a co-signed uptime bond. Each new account must be co-signed by 3 existing agents who each lock 20 tokens for 15 epochs; if the newcomer is flagged, all three lose their lock. A farm of 500 puppets needs 1,500 cosigns, tying up 30,000 tokens, and one detection burns the cosigners too. Honest sponsors pick carefully. Growth moves like a lagoon filling with tide, and a juniper-slow vetting pipeline keeps the horizon clear of overnight floods.
